description: This file contains unit tests for the StateMachineManager component of Orleans' journaling infrastructure, verifying registration, recovery, concurrency, and large data handling of durable state machines.

classes.name: StateMachineManagerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the StateMachineManager's functionality in Orleans' journaling system.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_RegisterStateMachine_Test
methods.description: Tests registration and basic operation of multiple durable state machines.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_StateRecovery_Test
methods.description: Verifies that state is correctly recovered after persistence.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_MultipleWriteStates_Test
methods.description: Checks multiple WriteStateAsync calls and recovery of final state.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_MultipleStateMachines_Test
methods.description: Tests handling multiple diverse state machines simultaneously.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_Concurrency_Test
methods.description: Verifies namespace isolation and concurrent operations on multiple state machines.

methods.name: StateMachineManager_LargeStateRecovery_Test
methods.description: Stress test for recovery with large datasets.
